title: Mulligatawny Spiced Lentil Soup

description: Mulligatawny Spiced Lentil Soup is a vibrant and aromatic Indian classic, perfectly blending the goodness of lentils with a symphony of spices. This comforting and hearty soup offers a delightful warmth, making it an ideal meal for any day. Each spoonful brings a burst of authentic Indian flavors, promising a truly satisfying experience.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients and Start Lentils
instructions.text: Rinse the red lentils thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. In a large pot or Dutch oven, combine the rinsed lentils with 4 cups of vegetable broth or water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In a separate large pan or skillet, heat the vegetable oil or ghee over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds. Once the mustard seeds begin to pop, add the finely chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant.

instructions.title: Add Spices and Tomatoes
instructions.text: Stir in the curry powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder to the pan with the aromatics. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to toast the spices. Add the diced tomato and bay leaf, cooking for about 3-4 minutes until the tomatoes soften slightly and release their juices.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Carefully transfer the sautéed aromatic and spice mixture from the pan into the pot with the simmering lentils. Stir well to combine all ingredients. Continue to simmer, uncovered, for another 10-15 minutes, or until the lentils are very tender and have broken down to thicken the soup. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Stir in Coconut Milk and Season
instructions.text: Remove the bay leaf. Stir in the full-fat coconut milk, fresh lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to taste. Mix thoroughly and heat through for 2-3 minutes, but do not bring to a rolling boil after adding the coconut milk to prevent separation.

instructions.title: Serve Garnish and Enjoy
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Mulligatawny Spiced Lentil Soup into serving bowls. Garnish generously with fresh chopped cilantro. Serve immediately with a side of warm naan bread, rice, or crusty bread for a complete and comforting meal.

tips: For a richer flavor, toast the dry spices (cumin seeds, coriander seeds) whole in a separate pan before grinding them fresh. This enhances their aroma significantly.
If you prefer a smoother soup, you can use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup to your desired consistency. Be careful not to over-blend if you like some texture.
Mulligatawny soup tastes even better the next day as the flavors meld. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.
